options.content:
# AI Gateway

This dashboard monitors the **AI Gateway** — the internal proxy that routes, load-balances, and tracks spend for all LLM API traffic across teams — plus **Amazon Bedrock**, **Google Vertex AI (aiplatform)**, and **Azure AI Foundry** invocation metrics broken out per model.

**What to look at first:**
- **Overview** — total requests, failures, spend, and token usage over the selected time range, plus current model/provider health.
- **Deployment Health** — health-check failure rates and cooldown events per model deployment.
- **Proxy Overview** — request/failure rates and latency for the proxy itself.
- **Budget** — remaining budget per team and per virtual API key.
- **Latency / Redis & Postgres / Spend Queue Backpressure** — infrastructure-level performance and backpressure indicators.
- **Usage by Model & Virtual Key** — token and spend breakdowns for cost attribution.
- **LLM API Rate Limits** — remaining rate-limit headroom reported by upstream providers.
- **Amazon Bedrock** — invocation count and latency, token usage (input/output, per model and daily), throttles, client/server errors, and estimated TPM quota usage, broken out per Bedrock model via CloudWatch metric-math — new models appear automatically.
- **Google Vertex AI (aiplatform)** — invocation count and latency, first-token latency, token and character usage (input/output), errors by response code, and Provisioned Throughput consumption.
- **Azure AI Foundry** — invocation count and latency, time to first token, prompt/generated token usage, errors by model deployment and status code.

Expand the **AI Gateway**, **Amazon Bedrock**, **Google Vertex AI (aiplatform)**, and **Azure AI Foundry** sections below to see their panels.

targets.expr: ((count((((sum by (litellm_model_name, requested_model) (increase(litellm_deployment_failure_responses_total{api_key_alias="litellm-internal-health-check",container="litellm"}[5m]))) / clamp_min(sum by (litellm_model_name, requested_model) (increase(litellm_deployment_total_requests_total{api_key_alias="litellm-internal-health-check",container="litellm"}[5m])), 1)) > 0)))) / clamp_min((count(sum by (litellm_model_name, requested_model) (increase(litellm_deployment_total_requests_total{api_key_alias="litellm-internal-health-check",container="litellm"}[5m])))), 1) * 100

panels.description: Failure percentage of health-checked models, broken out by api_provider. Previously hardcoded to Bedrock only — now covers all providers.
panels.title: Provider Failing (%) by Provider

targets.expr: ((sum by (litellm_model_name, requested_model) (increase(litellm_deployment_failure_responses_total{api_key_alias="litellm-internal-health-check",container="litellm"}[5m])) or (sum by (litellm_model_name, requested_model) (increase(litellm_deployment_total_requests_total{api_key_alias="litellm-internal-health-check",container="litellm"}[5m])) * 0)) / clamp_min(sum by (litellm_model_name, requested_model) (increase(litellm_deployment_total_requests_total{api_key_alias="litellm-internal-health-check",container="litellm"}[5m])), 1) * 100)

Invocation Count
panels.description: Number of Bedrock invocations, broken out per model via a CloudWatch metric-math SEARCH() expression — new models appear automatically, nothing to update here when Bedrock adds one.

panels.title: Invocation Latency
panels.description: Average invocation latency per model.

panels.title: Token Counts by Model
panels.description: Total input and output token counts per model, per period (Sum).

panels.title: Token Counts by Model (Largest Single Request/Response)
panels.description: Largest single request's input tokens and largest single response's output tokens, per model, per period (Maximum) — flags unusually large individual calls.

panels.title: Daily Total Tokens by ModelId
panels.description: Input and output tokens per model, per day, stacked — the bar height is the combined total. Shown as two stacked series rather than a summed one because CloudWatch Metric Math cannot add two multi-series (per-model) arrays together.

panels.title: InputTokenCount, OutputTokenCount
panels.description: Total input and output tokens across all models.

panels.title: Requests, grouped by input tokens
panels.description: AWS's native metric-based bucketing: PR(lo:hi) (percentile rank) on InputTokenCount gives the share of calls in each range; multiplying by SampleCount converts that share into an actual call count. Works off standard AWS/Bedrock metrics — no invocation logging required.

targets.label: Calls with input tokens under or at 8,800

panels.title: Invocation Client Errors
panels.description: Client-side invocation errors (bad requests, invalid input, auth issues etc.). Replaces the broken CloudTrail-based Throttling (WIP) panel, which queried a CloudTrail log group in eu-west-2 that never captured Bedrock activity (Bedrock is in eu-west-1).

panels.title: Invocation Server Errors
panels.description: Server-side invocation errors (failures on AWS/Bedrock's side).

panels.title: Estimated TPM Quota Usage
panels.description: Estimated tokens-per-minute quota usage per model — the early warning signal for throttling before InvocationServerErrors start climbing.

panels.title: Legacy Model Invocations
panels.description: Invocations of models AWS has marked as legacy/deprecated, per model. Any non-zero value here means someone is still calling a model due for retirement.

panels.title: Invocation Count
panels.description: Number of Vertex AI publisher-model (Gemini and Model Garden partner models) invocations, broken out per model via an MQL group_by — new models appear automatically, nothing to update here when Vertex AI adds one.

panels.title: Invocation Latency
panels.description: p99 model invocation latency per model (time from request received to full response returned).

panels.title: Token Counts by Model
panels.description: Accumulated input and output token counts per model, per period (Sum), split by the 'type' label (input/output).

panels.title: Character Counts by Model
panels.description: Accumulated input and output character counts per model — Vertex AI bills and quotas some models (e.g. Gemini on-demand) by character count rather than tokens, so this is the direct cost/quota signal, split by 'type' (input/output).

panels.title: Errors by Model and Response Code
panels.description: Model invocations broken out by non-200 response code, per model — the Vertex AI equivalent of Bedrock's client/server error panels. Any non-zero value here means requests to that model are failing.

panels.title: Provisioned Throughput Consumption
panels.description: Overall throughput consumed per model (accounting for burndown rate), in characters — the Vertex AI equivalent of Bedrock's EstimatedTPMQuotaUsage. Only meaningful for models with Provisioned Throughput purchased; on-demand-only models will show flat/no data here.

panels.title: Invocation Count
panels.description: Number of Azure AI Foundry model calls (Models → HTTP Requests category, metric ModelRequests), broken out per model deployment via the ModelDeploymentName dimension — new deployments appear automatically, nothing to update here when a new model is deployed. Note: the legacy Cognitive Services TotalCalls/Latency metrics do NOT support splitting by ModelDeploymentName (only ApiName, OperationName, Region, RatelimitKey) — use the Models-category or Azure OpenAI-category metrics instead, as done here.

panels.title: Invocation Latency
panels.description: Average time to last byte per model deployment — time from request received to the full response being returned (Models → Latency category, metric TimeToLastByte). Note: the legacy Cognitive Services 'Latency' metric isn't valid for Azure OpenAI/AI Foundry workloads and doesn't support the ModelDeploymentName dimension, so it isn't used here.

panels.title: Time to First Token
panels.description: Average time-to-first-token per model deployment for streaming requests — the responsiveness signal for chat/completions traffic, distinct from overall Invocation Latency above.

panels.title: Token Counts by Model
panels.description: Accumulated prompt and generated (completion) token counts per model deployment — Azure OpenAI reports these as two separate metrics rather than a single metric split by type, so prompt and generated tokens are queried and aliased separately here.

panels.title: Errors by Model and Status Code
panels.description: Model calls broken out by non-200 HTTP status code, per model deployment (Models → HTTP Requests category, metric ModelRequests, which supports both the ModelDeploymentName and StatusCode dimensions together) — the Azure AI Foundry equivalent of Bedrock/Vertex's error panels. Any non-zero value here means requests to that deployment are failing.
